# GFM audit fixture

`gfm-spec.txt` is an unmodified snapshot of the official cmark-gfm specification test source:
https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/master/test/spec.txt

GFM version 0.29, 2019-04-06. Specification by John MacFarlane and contributors, with GitHub Flavored Markdown extensions. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, as identified in the source front matter:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The snapshot SHA256 is recorded in `docs/gfm-audit.json`. Audit result files quote the corresponding examples under the same attribution/license. The project's MIT license does not replace this fixture license.
